title: 1:1 Prep - Ethan Morales & Olivia Hart - 2026-08-12
body:
Goal for this 1:1: quick sync to align on ACME Corp renewal prep, surface risk signals, decide ask list for AE/SE play, and capture action items.  Keep it 30m.

High-level context:
- Account: ACME Corp (Enterprise, Finance vertical).  Primary contacts: Olivia Hart (AE), Jordan Lee (CTO), Priya Nair (Head of ML).
- Current state: On Redwood Dedicated, running fin-invoice-generation pipeline. Usage stable but token volume spiked 20% in July due to tax season. Renewal up for negotiation on 2026-09-20.
- Health indicators: latency P95 slightly degraded (200ms -> 260ms) when peak concurrency >30; cost per 1k tokens trending up due to unbatched short requests.
- Open tickets: CS-3421 (inference mem leak on v1.4.2 -> assigned to eng), CS-3478 (billing discrepancy July)

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick check-in (5m) - high-level mood, any urgent escalations?
2) Technical health update (7m) - share SRE/serving notes, root-cause for latency bump, ETA for CS-3421 fix.
3) Renewal posture (8m) - propose options (flat renewal, discount for committed usage, migration incentive to Dedicated v2) and target ask from AE.
4) AE/SE playbook items (5m) - collateral needed, customer workshop dates, SE involvement.
5) Action items & next steps (5m)

Prep items for Olivia (AE):
- Ask: confirm expected Q4 spend range (low/median/high) and key procurement timing.  Need by EOD 8/18.
- Bring any legal/procurement blockers (e.g., required SOC2 clause changes).
- Decide whether ACME prefers price stability (multi-quarter commit) vs. flexibility.

My talking points / notes to self:
- Emphasize that Dedicated v2 (quantization + batching improvements) can reduce per-token cost ~15-25% on their pattern.  Have rough numbers ready: current $0.045/1k -> proposed $0.035/1k with commit.
- Share that serving runtime team has a mitigation (config change) to reduce P95 latency spikes: reduce max batch window from 25ms -> 10ms for the ACME namespace as an interim.  Ask eng for a canary deploy before EOD 8/14.
- Follow up on CS-3421: confirm eng ETA (target fix branch 1.4.3 by 8/19).  If not, propose rollback to v1.4.1 for high-risk endpoints.
- Prepare customer-facing one-pager: 'ACME performance summary + recommended actions' (2-sided), due 8/20.  I can draft and ask Olivia to share with Jordan/Priya.

Risk signals to surface:
- Finance procurement window closes 9/05 for Q4 budgets — if ask not in by then we risk losing leverage.
- If latency persists during month-end batch jobs, they may evaluate other vendors; prioritize quick mitigation.
- Billing discrepancy (CS-3478) could sour renewal conversation if unresolved; status update needed before renewal negotiation.

Proposed asks to AE/SE during 1:1 (be explicit):
- AE (Olivia): confirm renewal owner & internal decision date; get commitment to introduce procurement contact to us by 8/20.
- SE: schedule 60m workshop with Jordan + Priya in week of 8/24 to run perf tune session + discuss batching/quantization tradeoffs.
- CS (me): produce the one-pager and a short runbook for on-call mitigation actions; deliver draft by 8/20.

Action items (capture):
- Olivia: confirm Q4 spend band and procurement timeline — due 2026-08-18 (owner: Olivia Hart).
- Me (Ethan): draft ACME performance one-pager + runbook — due 2026-08-20; share for review with Olivia/Samira.
- SE (assign to Aaron Li): schedule and prepare the 60m workshop with sample traces + proposed config changes — target week of 2026-08-24; invite list: Jordan, Priya, Olivia, Ethan.
- Eng/SRE (assign to platform-engineering): canary config change (batch window reduction) in ACME namespace — requested by 2026-08-14; update ticket CS-3421 with status.
- Finance Ops (Olivia): escalate billing ticket CS-3478 with billing team and get resolution estimate — due 2026-08-17.

Notes / follow-up items to capture during meeting:
- If customer asks for price protection through 2027, map to committed usage tiers + legal approval path.
- If Jordan asks for performance SLA, run numbers with SRE on expected P95 after mitigation; avoid over-promising before patch.

Quick links to pull into convo (have open tabs):
- CS-3421 ticket (eng notes)
- Billing ticket CS-3478
- Last month usage report (Drive: ACME_usage_July_2026.xlsx)
- Prior renewal brief: ACME_renewal_q1_2025.docx

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send right after call):
Hi Olivia / Jordan / Priya — thanks for the sync today.  Recap and owners below.  Please flag if anything here is off.
- Action 1: ...
- Action 2: ...
(attach one-pager link)

Notes to self: keep this doc as scratchpad; after finalizing one-pager move a copy to Confluence ACME page + attach tickets.  Update status fields on 8/14 and 8/19.

Random quick reminders (personal):
- Ask Samira for any recent AE collateral on commit discounts (she's got the playbook).
- Remind eng to include regression test for mem leak in CI pipeline (ticket reference).

End of prep.
